TCWHU Mobile App - Privacy & Community Rules

About TCWHU Mobile App

TCWHU Mobile App is a private 1-on-1 messaging platform for TCWHU students. Users can find someone to chat with based on year, display name, and shared interests, while maintaining a safe and respectful environment.

Privacy Policy

1. Information We Collect
• Photo Verification: Selfie and valid TCU ID to confirm identity.
• Basic Details: Year level, display name (not real name), and interests.
• Chat Data: Messages are stored securely and are not shared publicly.

2. How We Use Your Data
• To verify user identity and prevent fake accounts.
• To recommend matches based on shared interests.
• To maintain a secure and respectful community.

3. Data Privacy & Security
Your data is encrypted and used solely for verification and moderation. We comply with the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (R.A. 10173). Personal information is never sold or shared externally.

Community Guidelines

1. Keep It Safe
- Do not use your real name.
- Do not share personal information such as address, contact number, or social media accounts.
- Photo verification is private and used only for authentication.

2. Be Respectful
- Avoid harassment, bullying, hate speech, or explicit content.
- Respect others’ privacy and boundaries.

3. Account Violations & Enforcement
- First offense: Warning
- Repeated offense: Temporary suspension
- Severe or continued violation: Permanent ban

4. Agreement & Compliance
By creating an account, you agree to follow TCWHU Mobile App’s Privacy Policy and Community Guidelines. Violations may result in account restrictions or removal. Your use of the app confirms compliance with R.A. 10173 for safe handling of your personal data.

TCWHU Mobile App aims to provide a secure, private, and respectful space for students to connect and communicate confidently.
